recipes.name: Truffle Pasta inspired by Broad City
ingredients: 1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste
instructions: Prepare the cheese wheel by removing the top and scoping out a ½ inch of cheese to create a shallow bowl. Leave about ½ cup of grated cheese in the ‘bowl’ of the wheel - 1 wheel parmesan cheese
Begin heating a large pot of water with salt over high heat. - 1 tbsp kosher salt + more to taste
Combine the butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Once the butter is foaming, turn off the heat, and grate about half of the truffle into the pan. Let the truffles infuse into the sauce. - 2 oz black truffles cleaned
Cook the fresh pasta in the boiling water for 8-9 minutes, or until al dente. - 8 oz dried bucatini pasta
Add the cooked pasta directly into the large skillet. Toss the pasta in the sauce and add about ¼ cup of pasta water to help emulsify.
Add the brandy to a small metal bowl. Ignite the brandy. - ¼ cup brandy
Very carefully, pour the brandy over the cheese wheel and stir with a large metal spoon to melt the cheese.
Add the pasta to the cheese wheel and toss to coat it evenly in the melted cheese.
Season to taste with salt. - 1 kosher salt + more to taste
Serve immediately and garnish with more sliced truffles and optionally, truffle pearls. - Optional: black truffle pearls
